components.name: Filled action
components.description: Compact action extracted from the portfolio pill; use anchors for links and buttons for actions.
components.html: 查看作品
components.css: .ds-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:10px 24px;gap:14px;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:999px;background:#111;color:#fff;font:400 16px/1.4 var(--font-body, "Portfolio Sans", "Portfolio CJK", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif);text-decoration:none;transition:background .18s,color .18s}.ds-pill:hover{background:#333;border-color:#333}.ds-pill:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #111;outline-offset:6px;}.ds-pill svg{flex-shrink:0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-pill{transition:none}}

components.name: Section navigation
components.description: Work/About section anchors; the header moves to two rows at 850px, with Contact as a separate filled action.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(28px,3.1vw,48px);font:400 16px/1.7 var(--font-body, "Portfolio Sans", "Portfolio CJK", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif)}.ds-nav a{padding:10px 0;color:#111;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:7px}.ds-nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #111;outline-offset:6px;}@media(max-width:850px){.ds-nav{gap:28px}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-nav{gap:24px;font-size:15px}}

components.name: Native language selector
components.description: Native four-language selector, 132px wide; localized accessible label and route/preference behavior are supplied by Portfolio.tsx.
components.css: .ds-language{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;color:#111}.ds-language select{font:400 14px/1.7 var(--font-body, "Portfolio Sans", "Portfolio CJK", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif);min-height:48px;width:132px;padding:10px 32px 10px 16px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:999px;appearance:none;background:#fff;color:#111;cursor:pointer}.ds-language select:hover{border-color:#999}.ds-language select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #111;outline-offset:6px}.ds-language>svg{position:absolute;right:13px;pointer-events:none}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-language select{min-height:44px;font-size:16px}}

components.name: Gray-stage project card
components.description: Authentic LogicDuo screenshot embedded unchanged from public/images/logicduo-cover.png. Visual preview of a project button; Portfolio.tsx supplies native-dialog behavior.
components.css: .ds-project{display:block;width:100%;border:0;padding:0;background:transparent;color:#111;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font:400 17px/1.7 var(--font-body, "Portfolio Sans", "Portfolio CJK", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif)}.ds-project:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #111;outline-offset:6px;}.ds-cover{display:flex;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1.3;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;background:#eee;padding:clamp(24px,3.8vw,50px)}.ds-preview{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.ds-caption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-top:22px}.ds-project-title{display:block;font-size:clamp(27px,2.3vw,32px);line-height:1.3;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-project-summary{display:block;margin-top:8px;color:#666;font-size:clamp(16px,1.4vw,18px);line-height:1.5}.ds-caption>svg{flex-shrink:0;color:#707070;transition:transform .25s}@media(hover:hover){.ds-project:hover .ds-preview{transform:scale(1.025)}.ds-project:hover .ds-caption>svg{transform:translateX(5px)}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-cover{aspect-ratio:1.45;padding:28px}.ds-caption{margin-top:20px}.ds-project-title{font-size:29px}.ds-project-summary{font-size:16px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-preview,.ds-caption>svg{transition:none}}

components.name: Native detail panel
components.description: Visual structure of the project dialog. Runtime showModal, Escape/backdrop dismissal, scroll lock, and focus restoration remain in src/components/portfolio/Portfolio.tsx.
components.html:
AllFeeds

开源分布式数据采集

项目背景

抓取一个页面很容易，持续维护不同来源、恢复失败任务和回填历史数据则需要一套基础设施。AllFeeds 将这些共性需求整理为可扩展的开源采集系统。
components.css: .ds-dialog{width:min(1000px,calc(100% - 64px));max-width:none;max-height:calc(100dvh - 64px);margin:auto;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:12px;overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-color:#aaa #f4f4f4;background:#fff;color:#111;font:400 17px/1.8 var(--font-body, "Portfolio Sans", "Portfolio CJK", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif)}.ds-dialog::backdrop{background:rgb(0 0 0 / 32%)}.ds-dialog[open]{animation:ds-appear .2s ease-out}.ds-dialog-bar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 24px;background:#fff;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;color:#666}.ds-dialog-bar button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#eee;color:#111;cursor:pointer}.ds-dialog-bar button:hover{background:#ddd}.ds-dialog-bar button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #111;outline-offset:6px;}.ds-dialog-body{padding:16px clamp(24px,5vw,64px) 64px}.ds-dialog-body h2{margin:0;font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,48px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.025em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-detail-summary{margin:16px 0 36px;color:#666;font-size:17px}.ds-project-detail{max-width:72ch;margin:38px 0}.ds-project-detail h3{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:21px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500}.ds-project-detail p{margin:0;color:#444}@keyframes ds-appear{from{opacity:.5;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-dialog{width:calc(100% - 24px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px)}.ds-dialog-bar{padding:10px 16px}.ds-dialog-body{padding:18px 24px 40px}.ds-detail-summary{margin-bottom:26px}.ds-project-detail{margin:30px 0}.ds-project-detail h3{font-size:20px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-dialog[open]{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
A calm editorial presentation uses white paper, black actions, neutral gray image stages, and regular sans-serif type. Real product imagery supplies the color and visual detail. Broad white margins and generous vertical spacing give each piece of work room to be inspected.

This system governs the independent `personal-portfolio` project and its four language pages. It preserves the approved Pearl composition and later centered-width correction. The original personal site is a separate project; its visual tokens and runtime do not govern this portfolio. Work, biography, contact, and project dialogs are the current surface.
keyCharacteristics: Centered content with visible white space on both sides.
Regular sans-serif hierarchy and compact black pill actions.
Complete, original-color product images centered on identical gray stages.
Captions outside images, flat surfaces, and project detail on demand.
Native language selection, native scrolling, keyboard-visible focus, and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Complete Image Rule
rules.body: Keep every product image complete, centered, and in its original colors. The gray stage belongs around the image; it must not tint, crop, or replace the product UI.

rules.name: The Regular Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve the quiet weight hierarchy. CJK display text needs comfortable line height; visual emphasis comes from scale and space rather than heavy weight.

rules.name: The Shared Width Rule
rules.body: Navigation, introduction, work, biography, contact, and footer share a centered outer container with maximum width 1120px and the frontmatter `page-gutter` inside it. This user correction supersedes the near-full-width approved composition. The maximum includes inner gutters under the project's border-box sizing.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Resting page surfaces and product cards have no shadows. White space, image-stage contrast, and functional borders provide separation. Modal depth comes from the native top layer and the backdrop token, not decorative elevation effects.

dos: Do apply these tokens to the independent four-language portfolio.
Do use the shared centered width and visible side whitespace confirmed by the user.
Do center complete, original-color product screenshots on the same gray stage and place captions below on white.
Do maintain regular sans-serif typography, locale-specific font stacks, and generous space between content groups.
Do reuse the native language selector and detail dialog with keyboard focus, contained scrolling, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain font licenses, asset source manifests, and the distinction between real UI images and generated studies.
donts: Don't restore near-full-width desktop covers or enlarge type without a new user decision.
Don't crop product screenshots to fill stages, tint them gray, or substitute generated dashboard UI.
Don't compress several projects into the opening introduction to demonstrate coverage.
Don't add shadows, decorative gradients, glass surfaces, or heavy display weight to this system.
Don't import the original personal site's visual system or runtime into this independent portfolio.
Don't present the local finish verdict or historical fidelity records as production deployment acceptance or an automated fidelity pass.
